# dislop

> Cutting AI slop is real productivity. Pluggable Editorial & Artifact Linter (Node.js 20+ Micro-Kernel, 11 modular Packs, Dual-Track Defect/Suggestion CI gates, Fact Gate, and 90 curated anti-slop tools) for coding agents, office agents, and human writers.

## Quick Start & Agent Setup
1. Evaluate: inspect host (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, or web) and deliverables; pick Skill, CLI, or MCP via [Tools & Setup](https://dislop.com/tools/index.md).
2. Install: Skill `npx --yes skills add dislop-ai/dislop --skill dislop`; CLI `npx --yes dislop init` (Node 20+ zero dependencies); Local stdio MCP `npx --yes dislop-mcp`; Remote MCP `https://dislop.com/mcp` (0-credit check, no login).
3. First check: `npx --yes dislop check <path> --no-llm --format agent` (exit `0`/`1`/`2`), fix `DEFECT`s first, and verify edits with `npx --yes dislop verify --git HEAD <path>`.

## Start by task
- [Brief](https://dislop.com/tasks/business-doc.md): AI artifacts and `en/prose` rules.
- [Web & slides](https://dislop.com/tasks/web-and-deck.md): `common/web-ui` & `common/slide-deck` rules and tokens.
- [Essay](https://dislop.com/tasks/editorial-writing.md): `en/prose` narrative guardrails and contrasts.
- [Pre-release gate](https://dislop.com/tasks/pre-release-gate.md): Objective `common/artifact-qa` `error` checks and `--since` PR diff gating.
